# Accepted npm audit advisories — high+ findings that are NOT reachable
# in our build/runtime. CI / `make audit` fails on any high+ advisory NOT
# listed here. Each entry MUST include a justification (why it's not
# reachable for us).
#
# Format: one GHSA id per line. Comments (#) and blank lines ignored.
#
# An entry npm audit no longer reports is deleted, not commented out: this
# file is only useful while every line in it describes a live advisory.

# fast-uri 3.0.0–3.1.5 — host confusion / SSRF cluster (skipped IDN
# canonicalization, malformed IPv6 normalization, repeated percent-decoding,
# percent-encoded scheme normalization). fast-uri is pulled by exactly one
# chain: @astrojs/check → @astrojs/language-server → volar-service-yaml →
# yaml-language-server → ajv → fast-uri (`npm ls fast-uri`).
# @astrojs/check is a devDependency — the `astro check` type-checker — and
# `npm ls fast-uri --omit=dev` is empty, so fast-uri is never in the runtime
# tree and never ships: production serves the static dist from the Go binary,
# which does no URI parsing with it. Not reachable. Clears when ajv (via the
# yaml language server) bumps to a fast-uri 4.x that carries the fix.
GHSA-5jgf-p345-68v8
GHSA-f65p-4m7j-42xc
GHSA-fph4-wmhf-6fwf
GHSA-jqff-g426-hqxp

# svgo 4.0.0–4.0.2 — two holes in `removeScripts`: executable links survive
# via namespace and content-type confusion, and executable HTML inside a
# <foreignObject> is only partly sanitized. Both mean an optimized SVG can
# keep script the pass was supposed to strip, and both only bite on SVG that
# someone else supplied. svgo arrives as a direct transitive of astro 7's SVG pipeline, and
# that pipeline never runs here: nothing imports an .svg file — every icon is
# inline markup in an .astro template, which svgo does not touch. It is also
# build-time only; the image copies `web/dist` and nothing else, so no part of
# node_modules ships. Not reachable. Clears when astro picks up svgo 4.0.3+.
GHSA-w27v-7q3p-w38r
GHSA-4vpr-x523-8j87

# http-cache-semantics <=4.2.0 — max-stale handling can serve one user's
# cached response to another. astro 7 depends on it for one file,
# assets/build/remote.js: the build-time cache of remote images fetched by
# astro:assets. Nothing in `web/src` imports astro:assets or renders
# <Image>/<Picture>/getImage, and astro.config.mjs allows no remote image
# domains, so that cache never runs. It is build-time
# only besides; the image copies `web/dist` and no node_modules ships. Not
# reachable. No fixed release exists yet (4.2.0 is the latest); clears when
# one does and astro picks it up.
GHSA-ch52-4w7c-c8xp

# braces <=3.0.3 — stack exhaustion on deeply nested brace patterns. Only
# chain: astro-eslint-parser → fast-glob → micromatch → braces, a lint-time
# devDependency; `npm ls braces --omit=dev` is empty.
# The patterns it expands are the repo's own eslint globs. Not reachable. No
# fixed release exists yet (3.0.3 is the latest); clears with the first one.
GHSA-vfj7-8cjw-p6xm
